tagline: A catalog tile (gh#1435): the framed picture with an overlaid circular favourite toggle, then an overline, the title (a heading wrapping the item link, clamped to two lines), a metadata row with `CatalogCardTag`s, a price caption and line (price + change), and a footer row. `variant="sealed"` frames a wider, unshadowed product picture. Geometry: `--editorial-catalog-card-*`.
usage: DO lay tiles out with `ResponsiveGrid preset="catalog"`.
